lessons.title: Survey Construction & Question Design
lessons.description: Craft unbiased survey items, avoid double-barreled and leading questions, and mitigate social desirability bias.

lessons.title: Sampling Strategies & Sample Representativeness
lessons.description: Master probability sampling (random, stratified, cluster) vs. non-probability sampling (convenience, snowball), and response rates.

lessons.title: The Nature of Correlational Relationships
lessons.description: Interpret scatterplots, Pearson's r, Spearman's rho, correlation strength and direction, and restriction of range.

lessons.title: Correlation vs. Causation: Directionality & Third Variables
lessons.description: Unpack why correlation does not imply causation: reverse directionality, confounding third variables, and spurious relationships.
